metadata.description: Hub name: the DNS label (<name>.<region>.azurecontainer.io) and the prefix of the resources. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
Azure region (default: the resource group's).
longarm-hub image. Pin a version (ghcr.io/<owner>/longarm-hub:X.Y.Z) for reproducible upgrades; :latest is the newest release, :edge the main branch.

The hub's liveness probe. live: `longarm-hub healthcheck --live`, which also passes while the container start (Litestream restore, bootstrap) is still running and alive, so a long restore is not killed and a dead hub is restarted within minutes. legacy: plain `healthcheck` after 30 minutes, for images without --live (releases up to 0.1.17). auto: legacy for an image pinned to such a release, else live.
Hub size: small = 1 vCPU / 1.5 GB, medium = 2 vCPU / 3 GB.

Serve the web panel and install scripts over HTTPS on 80/443 with a Let's Encrypt certificate for the azurecontainer.io name: a Caddy sidecar (storageAuth key), or the hub itself with the certificate in its replicated database (storageAuth identity).
E-mail for Let's Encrypt expiry notices (optional).

Caddy image of the panel sidecar (storageAuth key), pinned by digest (deploy/azure/mirror-images.txt). deploy.sh --acr points it at its copy in the registry, <acr>.azurecr.io/mirror/caddy:<hex>@sha256:<hex>, so nothing is pulled from Docker Hub.
Send container logs to a new Log Analytics workspace (about 2-3 USD per GB ingested).

Telemetry (docs/telemetry.md): a Log Analytics workspace and a workspace-based Application Insights resource the hub sends the fleet's scrubbed telemetry to. With storageAuth identity the hub authenticates with its managed identity (Monitoring Metrics Publisher) and the resource accepts no instrumentation-key ingestion.
Days Application Insights / Log Analytics keep telemetry.

Diagnostic bundles (longarm diag --upload): a blob container "diagnostics" the hub writes with its managed identity (storageAuth identity only), deleted by a lifecycle rule after diagnosticsRetentionDays.
Storage redundancy of the account holding the Litestream replica and the state share.
Lifetime in hours of the one-time admin join code created on the first start.

UDP port of the longnet relay (QUIC + STUN); the second STUN port is this + 1. Not 7443: ACI refuses one port number for TCP and UDP (DuplicateContainerPorts / DuplicateIpAddressPorts). Workers listen on longnet://<fqdn>:<port>?tcp=<fqdn>:7443 (the relay TLS fallback uses the hub TCP port).

External STUN servers the hub advertises to the nodes next to its own STUN ports (comma-separated host:port; empty = only its own). ACI rewrites the source address of inbound UDP, so the hub's own STUN answers are useless there: direct (peer-to-peer) connections need these (README "Direct connections").
Expiry of the Litestream SAS (blob container scoped); every deployment (deploy.sh re-run) renews it.

How the hub reaches its storage account. key: the account key (Azure Files share for the data dir, a SAS for Litestream). identity: a user-assigned managed identity with Storage Blob Data Contributor on the replica container and shared key access off, for subscriptions whose policy denies it: no file shares, the data dir is the container's own disk and the CA is kept in the replicated database (LONGARM_HUB_CA_IN_DB), and the hub serves the panel over https itself (no Caddy; its certificate in the database too). Needs Owner or User Access Administrator on the resource group (role assignments).

storageAuth identity: an Azure Container Registry (in this resource group) the managed identity pulls from (AcrPull): the hub image if it is there, and the sidecar images when caddyImage / headscaleImage point at it (deploy.sh --acr: its mirror/ copies). Empty: registryUsername or anonymous.
Registry login for a private image (empty = anonymous pull).

Self-hosted Tailscale control plane: a Headscale sidecar in the container group (README "Headscale"). The hub serves its endpoints on https://<fqdn> (same certificate), keeps its database in the blob container "headscale" (Litestream), its private keys and API key in the hub's database, and mints the nodes' tailnet keys with it ([tailnet] provider headscale). Needs enablePanel; about 9 USD/month more.

Headscale image of the sidecar (the -debug image: its busybox shell runs the start script that waits for the hub), pinned by digest (deploy/azure/mirror-images.txt). deploy.sh --acr points it at its copy in the registry, <acr>.azurecr.io/mirror/headscale/headscale:<hex>@sha256:<hex>, pulled with the managed identity.
Headscale: also give nodes Tailscale Inc.'s public DERP map (relay fallback through their servers). Off: only the hub's embedded DERP relay, so relayed traffic stays on the hub.
Optional Tailscale OAuth client secret for the hub's [tailnet] provider (deploy/hub/README.md "Tailnet provider").
Optional: sign-in with Microsoft Entra ID (docs/usage.md "Sign in with Microsoft Entra ID"): the directory (tenant) ID. Empty: no Entra sign-in.
Entra sign-in: the app registration's application (client) ID.
Entra sign-in: admins, comma-separated (user@example.com, *@example.com or object IDs).
Entra sign-in: applications whose app-only tokens may sign in as a Longarm user (CI through GitHub OIDC), comma-separated "<app id>=<user>". Never admins, never the panel.
Scheduler memory gate: free GB a worker needs for scheduled jobs (empty = the hub's default, 20). Lower it for small workers (containers, laptops).
Minisign public key line (RW...) releases are signed with: the hub refuses uploaded releases whose signature does not verify (empty = no check).

Entra sign-in for the web panel: spa (no credential; SPA redirect URI https://<fqdn>/auth/spa-callback), confidential (storageAuth identity: the managed identity as a federated credential; Web redirect URI https://<fqdn>/auth/callback) or off.

variables.headscaleScript:
set -e
d=/headscale
chown 65532:65532 "$d"
chmod 0750 "$d"
echo "headscale: waiting for longarm-hub to prepare $d"
until [ -f "$d/ready" ]; do sleep 1; done
exec /ko-app/headscale serve --config "$d/config.yaml"

metadata.description: Hub address for longarm join / longarmd join.
Web panel and install scripts (empty without the panel).
UDP port of the longnet relay (workers: --listen longnet://<fqdn>:<port>).
storageAuth identity: the managed identity's principal ID (empty with key).
Application Insights resource (empty without enableTelemetry).
storageAuth identity: blob URL of the release files container (empty with key: they are on the state share).
Headscale control URL (tsnet ControlURL) the nodes get from the hub (empty without the sidecar).
Blob URL of the diagnostics container (empty without it).
